diffSummary: Bootstrap uses the selected GitHub Environment and maps only that environment's secrets into suffixed CLI variables.

Staging is restricted to develop; production is manual-only from main with staging source acceptance, immutable SHA/version checks, GitHub Environment approval, explicit production approval, and backup confirmation.
Release order is statically enforced as migration, Railway API deployment, API readiness/version verification, Cloudflare Pages deployment, then final API/web verification.
Infrastructure state is checkpointed as a short-lived Actions artifact and committed without secrets, including interrupted bootstrap runs when a checkpoint exists.
npm, GitHub, Cloudflare, Railway, Supabase API/PostgreSQL network failures stop immediately with an explicit VPN hint and no blind retry.
Workflow YAML and deployment policy have a repository-owned static validator plus regression tests.
Monorepo version scripts now target apps/web, fingerprint full source/deployment facts, synchronize root and web versions, and accept pnpm's argument separator.

verification.offlinePlan: staging and production passed without network or mutation
verification.credentiallessPreflight: expected failure; missing variable names only
verification.productionReleaseFailClosed: expected failure before state/network with no credentials
verification.networkGuard: VPN hint and no-retry behavior covered by tests

rationale: Make GitHub Actions environment-isolated, production-gated, ordered, recoverable, and explicit when overseas dependencies are unreachable.
